physical_readout: An example, not another primary endpoint: the most frequent distinct unordered informative degree spectra in this transfer were [4,4,4] versus [3,3,5] among the occupied exterior neighbors with BOTH candidates empty. Filling the former promotes 4,4,4 -> 5,5,5 and leaves 3,3,5 untouched: all six then lie at a species-preferred degree (3 or 5). Filling the latter leaves three degree-4 neighbors and promotes 3,3,5 -> 4,4,6: all six then have even degree. The candidate particle itself has the same degree in both placements. The former end was favored and occupied in 2086/2086 opportunities with that pattern; these edges are not independent replicates. Exact odds integrated over all fixed-composition species assignments, not just these six preferred-degree indicators.
scope: All translation- and cubic-invariant vacancy pair energies restricted to squared radii 1,2,3 tie on these edges. The result discriminates this restricted conditional benchmark, not arbitrary longer-range/anisotropic pair laws, equilibration, a new phase or a causal mechanism. No new physical states or trajectories; no rescore. A/B never supplied as candidate inputs. Distinct from decoration of a fixed mask or old shell-to-tripod comparisons.
